concept.title: Whitelist domains
concept.shortdesc: This section describes the domains that you need to whitelist.

conbody.p: This section describes the domains that you need to whitelist.
Whitelist the following domains to ensure uninterrupted connection and data processing. This is required for the device to safely connect to essential services.

ul.li: *.otosensesms.com - To direct communications and data exchange between an and the .
*.amazonaws.com - To communicate securely with AWS resources because the relies on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
The does not currently support IP address whitelisting. For more information on firewalls that support AWS IP ranges, see Firewall support for AWS IP ranges.
If you need to whitelist the device MAC addresses on your network, the MAC addresses are available upon request.
